text:
Sam: Heads up — I've been cleaning up our deploy snippets. Idea: a tiny 'compact' CLI that expands macros and includes safety hooks.
Lina: That would be amazing. Current runbooks are a mess.
Marco: Can we make these reversible by design? i.e., every deploy emits a reversible manifest with promote/rollback helpers.
Priya: I experimented with a `--profile` flag that maps to a sequence: preflight -> canary -> promote -> pin. It saved ~3 mins per release.
Alex: For on-call, small surface area. default profile should be conservative: canary=2, auto-rollback=true, snapshot=false.
Sam: Sketch of syntax: `deploy do cart-api@sha:deadbeef profile=patch window=2026-03-25T03:00/04:00 note="fix null pointer" --preview`
Marco: Love `--preview`. release-bot could print the final expanded command and the resulting planned rollout steps.
ops-bot: When preflight is set, I will post a checklist in channel and require two approvals unless `--auto-approve` is supplied.
Priya: Implementation note: keep profile defs in infra/deploy-profiles.yaml so teams can add custom ones.
Lina: Security: long pins should require `pin-justification`. release-bot should reject pins longer than 24h for enterprise orgs without justification.
Alex: Add `--escape` shorthand to trigger immediate rollback of a recent deploy: `deploy escape service=cart-api reason="incident paging"` — 2-step confirm.
Marco: Also a `deploy template gen` command to output a one-liner you can paste in docs. Example: `deploy template gen --service cart-api --profile=safe --window=2026-03-26T00:00/01:00`
Sam: What about db migrations? Add `--checkpoint` to snapshot schema + migration state to S3. Critical for rollback.
Priya: UX idea: `--notes-edit` opens a tiny form (title, summary, impact, rollback) and auto-saves to release notes store.
release-bot: I can implement server-side expansion + lint (pin compatibility, infra version match, metrics enabled). Prefer server-side to keep clients consistent.
Lina: Good. Who will own the first PR?
Marco: I'll do the macro expansion and the `template gen` endpoint.
Priya: I'll wire ops-bot checks and notes modal tests.
Alex: I'll add `--escape` flow and integration tests for rollback.
Sam: I'll draft the minimal deploy-profiles.yaml and a runbook snippet to paste into docs.
release-bot: Previewing expansion for `deploy do cart-api@sha:deadbeef profile=patch --preview`:
``
service=cart-api
ref=sha:deadbeef
profile=patch(canary=5,preflight=smoke,auto-rollback=true)
window=2026-03-25T03:00/04:00
notes="fix null pointer"
pin=false
``
Lina: Perfect. Let's keep the first iteration small and iteratively add `pin-justification` enforcement and `--checkpoint`. Thanks all. :rocket:
